Fry 6 Southwest Eggrolls, 12 Katie's Kickin Chicken Tenders, and 15 Buffalo Jack Wangs according to fry times. Make sure all items have been properly drained of grease using a Sav A Day accordingly.

Toss wings in Mild Sauce and place in 1/4 of a lined 16" black catering tray. Place 6 pieces of celery next to the wings. Place the Southwest Eggrolls and Katie's Kickin Chicken in 1/4 of the tray each.
Fill one each of a 6 oz squat with Ranch dressing, Honey Mustard, and Sweet Thai Chili Sauce and cover with 6 oz squat lids. Place sauces next to coordinating menu item (as shown) on on the tray.
Cover with 16" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.
Each of the black trays should be lined with three Mugshots basket liners.

steps.head: 50-Wing Platter
body: Make sure all wings have been properly drained of grease using a Sav A Day accordingly. Fill two 6 oz squats with Ranch dressing and cover with 6 oz squat lids.
Stack sauces and place in center of lined 16" catering platter. Toss wings in desired sauce and place around sauces on platter. Cover with 16" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.

steps.head: 50-Tender Platter
body: Make sure all tenders have been properly drained of grease using a Sav A Day accordingly. Fill two 6 oz squats with Ranch dressing and cover with 6 oz squat lids.

Stack sauces and place in center of lined 16" catering platter. Stack celery sticks around sauces. Place tenders around celery on platter. Cover with 16" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.

steps.head: 20-Southwest Eggroll Platter
body: Make sure all eggrolls have been properly drained of grease using a Sav A Day accordingly. Fill two 6 oz squats with Sweet Thai Chili sauce and cover with 6 oz squat lids. Stack sauces and place in center of lined 16" catering platter. Place eggrolls around sauces on platter. Cover with 16" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.
Each of the black trays should be lined with three Mugshots basket liners.

steps.head: Burger/Sandwich Platter
body: Cut burgers/sandwiches in half and place in a circle around the lined 16" platter. Cover with 16" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.

steps.head: Garnish Platter
body: Place1/3 cup diced red onions and 18 dill pickle chips in separate 6 oz squats in center of lined 12" tray. Secure product with 6 oz squat cup lids. Place 12 slices of tomatoes one side of platter.
Place 2 cups shredded burger lettuce on the remaining half of platter. Cover platter with 12" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.

steps.head: Chips/Cookie Platter
body: On lined 12" platter, place 6 bags of Lay's Plain Potato Chips on one half and place 6 packages of Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies on the other half. Cover platter with 12" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.

steps.head: Blackened Chicken Salad
body: Place 24 oz salad mix in 160 oz black plastic catering bowl. Top with 1 cup diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup diced red onions, 1 cup shredded mixed cheese, and 4 sliced blackened chicken breasts.

Seal with clear plastic lid for 160 oz bowl and place Mugshots sticker in center of lid. Fill two 6 oz squat cups with Ranch dressing (unless otherwise requested) and top with 6 oz squat cup lid. Dressing cups are served to the side.

steps.head: House Salad
body: Place 24 oz salad mix in 160 oz black plastic catering bowl. Top with 1 cup diced tomatoes, 1/2 cup diced red onions, 1 cup shredded mixed cheese, and 1 cup croutons. Seal with clear plastic lid for 160 oz bowl and place Mugshots sticker in center of lid. Fill two 6 oz squat cups with Ranch dressing (unless otherwise requested) and top with 6 oz squat cup lid. Dressing cups are served to the side.

steps.head: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
body: Place 24 oz chopped Romaine lettuce in 160 oz black plastic catering bowl. Top with 1 cup shredded parmesan cheese, 1 cup croutons, and 4 sliced grilled chicken breasts. Seal with clear plastic lid for 160 oz bowl and place Mugshots sticker in center of lid. Fill two 6 oz white squat cups with Caesar dressing (unless otherwise requested) and top with 6 oz squat cup lid.
Dressing cups are served to the side. Substitute 32 blackened shrimp if Shrimp Caesar Salad.

body: Place 6 packages of Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies on lined 12" platter. Cover platter with 12" Clear Dome Lid with Mugshots sticker in center.
Line the Mugshots paper box with Mugshots basket liner. Label with menu item inside using a Sharpie.
If requested, label with names as well.

steps.head: Burger/Sandwich Packing Procedure
body: Place burger/sandwich in center of insulated foil wrap. Fold one side of the foil on top of the burger/sandwich followed by the other side. Fold ends under burger/sandwich. Place wrapped burger in right side of lined box.

steps.head: Garnish Cup
body: Place 1 tbsp diced red onions and 3 dill pickle chips in equal halves in bottom of 6 oz squat cup topped with 1/3 cup shredded burger lettuce followed by a slice of tomato.
Place a 6 oz squat cup lid on top of cup and close to secure. Put garnish cup in lined box to the left of the burger/sandwich.
Lay's Potato Chips - Place on top of garnish cup Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies - Place upright behind garnish cup.
Place one each - ketchup, mustard, mayo packets in front of garnish cup and burger/sandwich. Place cutlery kit on top.
Line the Mugshots paper box with Mugshots basket liner. Label with menu item inside using a Sharpie. If requested, label with names as well.

steps.head: Tenders
body: Make sure that the 6 chicken tenders have been properly drained using a Sav-a Day.
Once drained, place tenders in lined box towards the front of the box.

steps.head: Dipping Sauce
body: Unless otherwise requested, fill a 2 oz souffle cup with honey mustard and top with a 2 oz souffle cup lid. Place cup in lined box with tenders.
Lay's Potato Chips - Place in back left corner Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies - Place in back right corner.
Line the Mugshots paper box with Mugshots basket liner. Label with food item using a Sharpie. If requested, label with names as well.

steps.head: Blackened Chicken Salad
body: Place 8 oz salad mix in lined box. Top with 1/3 cup diced tomatoes, 1/4 cup diced red onions, 1/2 cup shredded mixed cheese, and sliced grilled 6 oz chicken breast. Fill two 2 oz souffle cups with Ranch dressing (unless otherwise requested) and top with 2 oz souffle cup lid. Place dressing cups in opposite back corners of box.

steps.head: Grilled Chicken Caesar Salad
body: Place 8 oz chopped Romaine lettuce in lined box. Top with 1 oz shredded parmesan cheese, croutons, and sliced grilled 6 oz chicken breast. Fill two 2 oz souffle cups with Caesar dressing (unless otherwise requested) and top with 2 oz souffle cup lid. Place dressing cups in opposite back corners of box. Substitue 8 blackened shrimp if Shrimp Caesar Salad.
Grandma's Chocolate Chip Cookies - Place in back center of box between salad dressings.
Cutlery Kit is served on the side
